place.en: The bank of the Si River

setup.zh: 雨夜。泗水之畔，水声压过了一切。浅水里有一点银光，忽明忽暗，像在等谁。
setup.en: A night of rain. On the bank of the Si River, the water drowns out everything else. In the shallows a point of silver light flickers, as if waiting for someone.

exits.means: reaches into the water or touches the light
walks away from the light or ignores it

text.zh: 你走出十步。银光追着你的影子，不肯熄灭。
text.en: You walk ten paces. The light follows your shadow and will not go out.
